interpretation: Relationships derived from original retained Census 2020 PL94-171 geographic header block records, not the 2020-to-2010 comparability file. All statewide place parts included. Candidates: all reviewed place bindings intersecting existing reviewed MCDs or name-matched legacy town/township parent candidates, plus every unreviewed CSC name/state match to those Census places; unreviewed parent identities held; unreviewed identities held. Independent coextensive units are excluded by distinct town/subdivision identifiers. No rows added.
